title: Ali Qoder Receives a Major Upgrade: Launches Fast Mode with a Response Time of Just 3 Seconds and Significant Reduction in Consumption

content_html:
Ali Qoder officially announced the launch of a new Fast mode. The feature is available for desktop versions 0.4.4 and above, and can be used simultaneously by the personal edition, enterprise edition, CN version, and international version. The official also revealed that other products in the Qoder product family will also be integrated into this mode in the near future.

Regarding specific version experience and upgrades, the CN version has added a new Fast tier, offering a more efficient and economical option for daily tasks that require quick delivery. The international version directly upgraded the original Performance mode to the Fast mode, maintaining output quality. Original Performance users do not need to perform any actions and will automatically complete the upgrade.

From a core performance perspective, the Fast mode has achieved a dual breakthrough in "speeding up and reducing costs." The initial response time has been significantly reduced from 8 seconds in the previous Performance mode to 3 seconds, which is less than one-third of the Auto mode's response time, half of the international version's Performance mode, and about a quarter of the international version's Ultimate mode. At the same time, the Credits consumption has dropped from 1.1x to 0.8x, approximately a 27% reduction.

The official conducted a horizontal evaluation with 10 of the most common actual tasks by developers, comparing Qoder Fast with the Fast mode of similar products both domestically and internationally. The test results showed that Qoder completed the answers in just one-third the time of domestic similar products and one-fourth the time of international similar products, demonstrating highly competitive response speed and execution efficiency.
